member.name: M:SboxWeaponAnimator.WeaponCalibration.GetAnchor(SboxWeaponAnimator.AnchorKind)
member.summary: Resolves the single anchor of a fixed kind. Custom anchors are identified by id instead, because a weapon may carry several of them.

member.name: P:SboxWeaponAnimator.WeaponAnchor.GeneratedAttachmentName
member.summary: Attachment name emitted for custom anchors. Stored rather than derived so renaming the anchor cannot silently rename an attachment that game code already references.

member.name: F:SboxWeaponAnimator.WeaponAnimationNames.ReservedAttachmentNames
member.summary: Attachment names reserved by the fixed anchor kinds that reach generation. The calibration-only kinds (grip, bore markers) are never exported, so they reserve nothing.

member.name: M:SboxWeaponAnimator.WeaponAnimationNames.RepairCustomAnchorNames(SboxWeaponAnimator.WeaponAnimationDocument)
member.summary: Assigns each custom anchor a stable, unique attachment name. Mirrors : an existing stored name is kept whenever it is still unique, so generated output stays stable across renames.
